factories.name: new_generate_content_step
factories.description: Generate text or JSON Schema structured output with a Gemini model through the stateless models.generateContent method.

Content.description: Content is one conversation turn. Role is "user", "model", or empty for a single-turn request.

parts.description: Parts holds the turn's text parts in order. At least one part is required.

role.description: Role is "user", "model", or empty for a single-turn request.

Part.description: Part is one text part of a Content.

text.description: Text is the part text. It must not be empty.

inputSchema.description: GenerateContentRequest is the provider input for GenerateContent. Model accepts a model ID such as "gemini-3.5-flash-lite" or "models/gemini-3.5-flash-lite"; empty uses the connection's configured model. ResponseJSONSchema maps to generationConfig.responseJsonSchema and defaults ResponseMIMEType to application/json. ThinkingBudget maps to generationConfig.thinkingConfig.thinkingBudget: nil leaves the model default, -1 selects dynamic thinking, 0 disables thinking where the model allows it, and a positive value sets a token budget. Gemini 3 models treat thinkingBudget as a legacy setting that may not turn thinking off, and Google recommends their default temperature of 1.0, so leave ThinkingBudget and Temperature nil for them.

contents.description: Contents holds the conversation turns in order. At least one Content is required.

maxOutputTokens.description: MaxOutputTokens maps to generationConfig.maxOutputTokens and includes thought tokens. Zero leaves the model default; a negative value is invalid.

model.description: Model is the Gemini model ID, with or without the "models/" prefix. It overrides the connection's configured model for this request; empty uses the connection model.

responseJsonSchema.description: ResponseJSONSchema maps to generationConfig.responseJsonSchema and requires the application/json response MIME type. Nil omits it.

responseMimeType.description: ResponseMIMEType maps to generationConfig.responseMimeType. Empty omits it unless ResponseJSONSchema is set.

systemInstruction.description: SystemInstruction is optional system text sent as systemInstruction.parts[0].text.

temperature.description: Temperature maps to generationConfig.temperature and must be between 0 and 2. Nil leaves the model default.

thinkingBudget.description: ThinkingBudget maps to generationConfig.thinkingConfig.thinkingBudget. Nil leaves the model default, -1 is dynamic, 0 disables thinking where the model allows it, and a positive value is a token budget.
